topic: How can frequency planning address interference between satellite uplinks and broadband power line communication systems?
consensus_response: Frequency planning mitigates interference by allocating non-overlapping bands to satellite uplinks and broadband power line communication systems. Adaptive frequency hopping, cognitive radio techniques, beamforming, and polarization diversity optimize frequency allocation, reducing interference costs and enhancing spectral efficiency.
reference_context: Satellite communication systems operate on specific frequency bands, including S, L, Ku, and Ka bands, requiring careful planning to avoid interference with terrestrial systems.
